title: Canyon Home
content: The cliff dwellings in Dinotopia's Great Canyon would be a good place to spend time cut off from the world.Few people and few saurians visit this remote place. There's plenty of grain stored from the monthly resupply from ceratopsian harvest caravans.At sunset the golden light washes the tops of the towers and people sing in harmony out their windows, echoing a welcome to the night.We're starting to put some of the art prints back up in the online store. So far we have two favorites:Dream CanyonandGarden of Hope.
